title: Boolean influence
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, taking values in $\{\pm1\}$. The influence of coordinate $i$ is the uniform probability, over sign vectors $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, that flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\{\pm1\}$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
